digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and advanced command dispatch
propositions: Advanced command grammars are currently defined inline with manual dispatch instead of using reusable factory functions, causing duplicated argparse construction across bridge/reconciler/audit/workflow/identity/gate commands.
Current inline --help behavior produces 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms due to lack of centralized grammar management.

Parser factories must remain lean (no optional runtime imports like Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor) while supporting handler-specific presentation (usage, formatter_class, add_help parameters).
RebarArgumentParser.error() raises ParseError instead of SystemExit(2), requiring migrated handlers to catch both ParseError and SystemExit and preserve identical exit codes and stderr/usage bytes.
All advanced routes must register parser-factory references and be deterministically generation-ready for S2d without changing top-level help routing or execution behavior.

Commands with custom presentation (verify-opcert, verify-commit, verify-authorship, remote-cert, trusted-env, nested bridge parsers) must retain their exact historical --help output and parser behavior after migration.
